art_rules.guidance: Keep the supplied dusk workshop as the style and composition target. Preserve worn materials, layered props, cool outdoor depth and warm interiors.
Start with a 16 x 16 logical building grid and the design-plan character target near 32 x 48 px. Validate one character, one tank and one room before locking the atlas scale.
The reference is a 1672 x 941 flattened generated image. It does not reveal an exact original tile size, palette, animation atlas or hidden surfaces.
Proposed sizes are planning targets, not measured source sprite dimensions. Adjust the whole scale coherently if the first sample loses the reference detail.
Separate wall fills, collision-bearing floors, posts, foreground trim and decoration. Keep repeated textures and optional wear overlays independent.
Use body/back layer, liquid mask, glass/front details, indicator/emission layer and named ports. Reuse the same steel tank body for both instances.
Author benches, shelves, planters and racks empty. Place crates, jars, glassware, crops and mushrooms as independent contents.
Keep room lighting, purple grow light, oven glow and glass highlights controllable. A shared dusk grade applies to world layers, while HUD colours remain separate.
Connections are explicit variants. Preserve highlights when changing direction; arbitrary sprite rotation may rotate painted lighting.
Visible = appearance observed. Inferred = likely identity or completion geometry. Gameplay extension = additional behaviour or pieces beyond this still image.
Catalogue rows are families/components/effects, not a promised number of finished PNGs. Connector rows expand families and must not be added as new object families.
Share steel tank bodies, crate bodies, finished bottles, plant pots, lamp fixtures, window modules, leaf branding and hotbar frames.

assets.notes: Dark blue body, pale leaf logo, side window at the cropped front, black wheel arches, red rear lamp, grey bumper. Do not claim an exact full-vehicle silhouette from this partial view.

assets.name: Van open rear cargo doorway
assets.location: Van right/rear end
assets.variants: Visible: dark open cargo bay, inner panel and door edge. Proposed: closed door and 3–4 opening poses if interactive.
assets.notes: Separate rear door from body if the van opens on delivery. Interior crate art can reuse the storage crate family.

assets.name: Van wheel and tyre
assets.location: Lower left street under van
assets.variants: Visible: one clearly shown wheel. Proposed: reuse for unseen front wheel; 2–4 rotation frames if moving.
assets.notes: Dark tyre with a grey hub. An unseen wheel and its placement are completion work, not source evidence.

assets.name: Leaf business logo/decal
assets.location: Large pale mark on blue van; smaller marks on bags/crates
assets.variants: Visible: paired-leaf silhouette. Proposed: large decal and tiny stamp versions.
assets.notes: Maintain one shared logo design, with separately simplified tiny-size versions. Reuse for hanging shop sign and paper bag where appropriate.

assets.name: Complete van nose and travel states
assets.location: Offscreen vehicle front
assets.variants: Full nose, front wheel, optional opposite-facing van, brake/headlamp states.
assets.notes: The left side of the supplied image cuts through the van, so a whole drive-in/drive-out vehicle cannot be traced exactly from it.

assets.name: Black metal street lantern
assets.location: One near left van; one at right of shop
assets.variants: Visible: tall lantern with warm glass, stepped post and broad foot. Proposed: lit/unlit or separate emissive mask.
assets.layer: Street props; illumination is separate FX
assets.notes: Two placements appear to share the same basic design; use one reusable asset with small wear variation if needed. Keep the metal fixture separate from the light halo.

assets.name: Hanging leaf shop sign
assets.location: Upper-right exterior beside doorway
assets.variants: Visible: rectangular cream sign, leaf emblem, dark rim. Proposed: slight sway 3–4 frames only if desired.
assets.notes: The source shows the sign face and its hanging support. This is exterior signage, not a machine label.

assets.name: Shop sign wall bracket and chain
assets.location: To right of ground-floor roof/eave
assets.variants: Visible: short horizontal bracket and hanger. Proposed: left/right attachment and chain lengths.
assets.notes: Separate the bracket so sign placement can move with the doorway. The building eave itself belongs to the architecture inventory.

assets.name: Wooden fence segments
assets.location: Far-right street background and partly behind exterior figures
assets.variants: Visible: repeated vertical boards and rails. Proposed: middle segment, left/right ends and post.
assets.notes: The screenshot only reveals short fragments. Complete matching fence ends and a repeatable centre to support wider town layouts.

assets.name: Low hedge and shrub clumps
assets.location: Street margins; behind left van and near right house
assets.variants: Visible: dark blue-green and green clumps. Proposed: 3–4 reusable silhouettes, edge/centre variants.
assets.notes: Treat as discrete clusters with limited accent leaves, separate from terrain grass-edge tiles owned by architecture.

assets.name: Tree trunk and near foliage silhouette
assets.location: Background edges, especially right side
assets.variants: Visible: dark trunks/branches partly hidden by canopy. Proposed: 2–3 tree silhouettes and cropped edge variants.
assets.notes: Large trees frame the plot without competing with the bright building. Exact branches hidden behind the house must be reconstructed.

assets.name: Dusk sky colour field
assets.location: Full area behind roof and skyline
assets.variants: Visible: deep blue upper sky into violet/orange horizon. Proposed: one dusk backdrop; separate day/night palettes later.
assets.notes: Match the reference colour bands and horizon height first. It may be authored as a backdrop or rendered gradient, independent of the tile grid.

assets.name: Distant mauve cloud bank
assets.location: Left and right horizon above town
assets.variants: Visible: broad chunky mauve/purple cloud contours. Proposed: 3 wide repeatable cloud groups.
assets.notes: Use large silhouette clusters and lighter lower edges; no necessity to animate the entire bank for the first reconstruction.

assets.name: Thin pink/orange horizon cloud bands
assets.location: Lower sky between distant roofs
assets.variants: Visible: warmer thin horizontal strips. Proposed: 2–3 bands.
assets.layer: Far sky in front of sky field
assets.notes: These warm strips create the dusk contrast. Keep their contrast lower than windows and lamps.

assets.name: Far town roofline silhouettes
assets.location: Between foreground building and sunset, both sides
assets.variants: Visible: small gables, flat roof steps and chimneys. Proposed: 4–6 modular silhouette clusters.
assets.notes: The central foreground building hides much of the town. Wider play areas need invented continuations, not extraction of hidden buildings.

assets.name: Distant church/clock-tower silhouettes
assets.location: Left-of-centre skyline and large right skyline
assets.variants: Visible: pointed towers with cross/finial tops and small lit openings. Proposed: 2–3 tower silhouettes at different heights.
assets.notes: Some are cropped or partly occluded. Use the silhouette and warm window rhythm; their precise architectural identity is not certain.

assets.name: Small tower and chimney accents
assets.location: Skyline gaps beside large towers and roofs
assets.variants: Visible: small chimney stacks and narrow capped spires. Proposed: 3–5 small accents.
assets.notes: Reuse small skyline accents rather than making each one a bespoke building. Do not confuse background chimneys with the playable workshop roof stacks.

assets.name: Mid-distance pitched-roof houses
assets.location: Left gap above van and right town behind street lamp
assets.variants: Visible: cool-blue and purple house fronts, steep roofs, sparse glowing windows. Proposed: 3 house families.
assets.notes: Repeat window modules within each background house. These can be complete decorative sprites; they do not require playable interior collision.

assets.name: Near left cropped masonry house
assets.location: Leftmost image boundary
assets.variants: Visible: dark red tiled roof, pale-purple masonry, orange windows, chimney. Proposed: complete matching side only if camera travels left.
assets.notes: Large partial house establishes neighbourhood scale. Exact offscreen parts are unknown and should be marked as completion art.

assets.name: Near right gabled house
assets.location: Behind right lamp and passerby
assets.variants: Visible: steep dark roof, timber/gable pattern, purple plaster, warm windows. Proposed: full facade and partial edge crop.
assets.notes: This facade is more detailed than distant houses and should remain a separate depth layer. It is not part of the playable factory tileset.

assets.name: Window modules for background houses
assets.location: Scattered across all town depth layers
assets.variants: Visible: tiny amber squares and larger divided windows. Proposed: small single, tall single, divided double, lit/unlit.
assets.notes: Size and saturation change with depth. Reuse frames and layer an emissive window fill rather than baking every lit state into every house.

assets.name: Blue-green mid-distance tree canopy
assets.location: Town gaps and behind greenhouse glazing
assets.variants: Visible: overlapping angular foliage silhouettes. Proposed: 3 canopy clumps with two depth palettes.
assets.notes: The greenhouse reveals part of this layer through blue glass. Avoid drawing the town into the greenhouse asset itself.

assets.name: Rooftop shrub silhouettes behind main roof
assets.location: Above the upper roof near centre-left and centre-right
assets.variants: Visible: two loose foliage masses behind roofline. Proposed: 2 reusable clumps.
assets.notes: Their source position suggests distant or behind-roof foliage; do not assume they are harvestable crops. Moss attached to roof tiles belongs to architecture.

assets.name: Offscreen and occluded parallax continuations
assets.location: Beyond left/right edges and behind opaque workshop
assets.variants: Proposed: repeating joins, overlap-safe backing areas, independent camera movement margins.
assets.suggested_size: Per layer, wide enough for planned camera travel
assets.notes: A static screenshot can use the pictured composition. Camera panning needs additional hidden artwork and seamless layer extents.

assets.name: Warm interior room-light mask
assets.location: Kitchen, production floor, laboratory and right basement
assets.variants: Visible: amber pools and darker room corners. Proposed: one masked light system with adjustable radius/intensity.
assets.layer: Lighting over world, constrained by walls
assets.notes: The lighting is visible, but its implementation is inferred. Keep base sprites neutral enough to reuse under changing time-of-day lighting.

assets.name: Pendant and bare-bulb light cores
assets.location: Beneath ceiling fixtures across workshop
assets.variants: Visible: bright cream/yellow cores and small halos. Proposed: emissive mask per fixture shape.
assets.notes: Fixture sprites are owned by the equipment inventory. This item is only light emission and soft/local falloff.

assets.name: Greenhouse cool-white illumination
assets.location: Upper-left greenhouse
assets.variants: Visible: cool pale light on foliage and glass. Proposed: two light sources matching the two hanging fixtures.
assets.notes: Keep enough warm/cool contrast to distinguish greenhouse from laboratory. Do not tint every plant sprite permanently blue.

assets.name: Purple mushroom grow-light illumination
assets.location: Basement left above mushroom racks
assets.variants: Visible: pink-violet lamp strips and lilac spill onto fungi/wall. Proposed: thin emissive strip plus local coloured light.
assets.notes: The two tubes can reuse one light effect. The physical fixtures and mushroom art are listed by equipment.

assets.name: Street lantern amber halo
assets.location: Left and right lamp posts
assets.variants: Visible: bright lantern glass and small warm pool against blue town. Proposed: one reusable glow mask.
assets.suggested_size: 8–16 px core; 32–64 px light radius proposed
assets.notes: Separate from the metal lamp sprite and town windows so it can switch on at dusk.

assets.name: Window and doorway emission
assets.location: Town windows and shop entrance
assets.variants: Visible: orange/yellow interiors against cool surroundings. Proposed: emissive fills with optional on/off states.
assets.notes: Background window frames and foreground door structure remain independent art. Prevent emission from painting through solid walls.

assets.name: Furnace/oven fire glow
assets.location: Ground-floor kitchen stove/oven opening
assets.variants: Visible: small bright orange flame region. Proposed: 4–6 flame poses and gentle light pulse.
assets.notes: Only the still flame is observed. Animation and light pulse are proposed. The stove shell is equipment inventory.

assets.name: Sight-glass liquid and highlight rendering
assets.location: Copper kettle, receiver and steel vessel windows
assets.variants: Visible: yellow/orange contents with bright highlight pixels. Proposed: separate fill mask, meniscus and small bubble overlay.
assets.notes: Do not make a separate complete tank sprite for every fill level. Exact liquid species cannot be identified from colour alone. Rendering recipe uses MCH-013 window masks and glass artwork. Only an optional moving meniscus or bubbles needs extra effect art; do not duplicate the window sprite.

assets.name: Roof exhaust smoke plume
assets.location: Upper-right metal exhaust outlet
assets.variants: Visible: chunky lavender/grey puffs drifting upward/right. Proposed: 4–6 small puff sprites with fading alpha.
assets.layer: World particles behind foreground roof edge as needed
assets.notes: The plume is a visual effect; source stack and cap are equipment/architecture. A full screen smoke painting is unnecessary.

assets.name: Basement water glints and shallow ripples
assets.location: Floor beneath blue tank and pump
assets.variants: Visible: vivid blue pool with pale horizontal highlights. Proposed: 3–4 ripple frames and separate surface line.
assets.notes: Pool boundaries and floor shape belong to architecture; the blue water can come from the existing liquid simulation.

assets.name: Glass tint and reflection rendering
assets.location: Greenhouse panes, vessel windows and small bottles
assets.variants: Visible: blue/pale reflection strokes. Proposed: separate tint/highlight masks per glass shape.
assets.notes: Plant silhouettes remain visible through greenhouse panes. Do not bake reflected sky and plant objects into one greenhouse image. Rendering recipe only. Greenhouse reflection artwork is owned by ARC-GLS-06, so do not draw it twice.

assets.name: Local contact and under-beam shadows
assets.location: Under roof beams, shelves, machines and floor edges
assets.variants: Visible: narrow dark occlusion bands. Proposed: sprite shading plus selected separate contact-shadow decals.
assets.notes: The shadows are visible; a dynamic lighting implementation is optional. Keep permanent small form shading, but avoid baking large room lighting into every object. Reuse ARC-WAL-08 for ceiling/corner strips and ARC-ROOF-03 for eave shadow. Additional FX-012 decals are only the local contacts beneath machines, shelves and props.

assets.name: Depth darkening and underground falloff
assets.location: Soil corners and lower screen
assets.variants: Visible: darker outer soil and lower corners. Proposed: one world-space depth tint and restrained screen vignette.
assets.layer: Colour grade after world, before HUD
assets.notes: Match underground contrast without darkening the HUD. The screenshot cannot establish whether the original effect was dynamic or painted.

assets.name: Dusk colour grade
assets.location: Overall outdoor scene
assets.variants: Visible: blue/violet ambient exterior contrasted with amber workshop. Proposed: dusk ambient palette plus independent interior lights.
assets.notes: A single global blue overlay would also turn the interior blue. Keep interior warm-light contribution separately controllable.

assets.name: Running-machine and character motion effects
assets.location: Moving machines, walking people, deliveries
assets.variants: Optional: small steam bursts, pouring drips, footstep dust and interaction sparkle. Keep to effects actually used by mechanics.
assets.notes: Not observed as distinct effects in the reference. These are optional later polish and should not expand the static recreation milestone.

assets.name: Gold currency coin icon
assets.location: Top-left before 428
assets.variants: Visible: circular gold coin with dark rim and inner highlight. Proposed: one static icon; animated spin optional.
assets.notes: Keep HUD brightness independent of world dusk and underground lighting.

assets.name: Currency number glyphs
assets.location: Top-left: 428
assets.variants: Visible: white pixel numerals with dark/cool shadow. Proposed: complete digits 0–9 and required separators.
assets.notes: The source exposes only some glyphs; a complete font needs designed missing characters. Use a font or bitmap glyph atlas, not a 428 image.

assets.name: Full health heart
assets.location: Top-left: four bright red hearts
assets.variants: Visible: red heart, dark outline, small white/pink highlight. Proposed: one reusable full-heart icon.
assets.notes: Four placements share one design; they are not four unique assets.

assets.name: Depleted health heart
assets.location: Top-left: one dark fifth heart
assets.variants: Visible: dark red/brown filled heart silhouette. Proposed: one depleted state sharing the full-heart outline.
assets.notes: The final heart is visibly darker. A half-heart state is not clearly present.

assets.name: Partial-heart and damage feedback states
assets.location: Health display
assets.variants: Optional: half-heart, flashing hurt overlay, healing pulse.
assets.notes: These are gameplay extensions; the screenshot only establishes full and dark/depleted versions.

assets.name: Dusk time-of-day badge
assets.location: Top-right before 18:52
assets.variants: Visible: warm half-sun over pale blue horizontal horizon within purple/dark silhouette. Proposed: one dusk icon.
assets.notes: Keep the pictured badge as the first implementation. Sunrise/noon/night variants require new artwork.

assets.name: Clock numerals and colon
assets.location: Top-right: 18:52
assets.variants: Visible: pale pixel font. Proposed: reuse currency font where visual match allows, add colon and all digits.
assets.suggested_size: Same bitmap font family as currency
assets.notes: Clock is dynamic text, not one fixed image. Exact font source cannot be identified from this reference.

assets.name: Other time-of-day badges
assets.location: Top-right badge position
assets.variants: Proposed: dawn, day and night variants using same silhouette bounds.
assets.notes: Needed only if the clock advances visually beyond the chosen dusk reconstruction.

assets.name: Empty hotbar slot frame
assets.location: Bottom-centre eight-slot row
assets.variants: Visible: dark square panel, grey bevel and thin light inner edge. Proposed: one reusable normal slot.
assets.notes: Eight placements reuse one slot. Adjacent gaps and label baseline should be driven by layout rather than baked as a full strip.

assets.name: Selected/hovered/disabled slot states
assets.location: Bottom hotbar
assets.variants: Proposed: selected border, hover tint and disabled overlay.
assets.notes: No unambiguous strong selected-slot highlight is visible in the image. Do not invent a gold selection border as observed evidence.

assets.name: Pickaxe inventory icon
assets.location: Slot 1
assets.variants: Visible: diagonal grey pick head, brown shaft, blue/dark grip end. Proposed: one static inventory icon.
assets.notes: World-held pickaxe can reuse the design but needs a separate pivot and may need a different silhouette. It is not visible in a character hand here.

assets.name: Shovel inventory icon
assets.location: Slot 2
assets.variants: Visible: diagonal wooden handle and grey shovel blade. Proposed: one static icon.
assets.notes: Do not count identical world shovel art as already present; only the icon appears in the source.

assets.name: Blue watering-can inventory icon
assets.location: Slot 3
assets.variants: Visible: blue can with top handle and spout to right. Proposed: one static icon.
assets.notes: A held/world watering can would be a later asset using this design language.

assets.name: Seedling inventory icon
assets.location: Slot 4
assets.variants: Visible: two green leaves, stem and brown roots/soil clump. Proposed: one static icon.
assets.notes: Small stack count 3 is rendered separately. This icon is distinct from the larger greenhouse plant sprites.

assets.name: Wooden crate inventory icon
assets.location: Slot 5
assets.variants: Visible: brown crate at slight icon perspective, dark seams. Proposed: one static icon.
assets.notes: Inventory icons can be icon-style; playable world objects must preserve the scene side view. Do not force this perspective into the world crate.

assets.name: Tall blue bottle inventory icon
assets.location: Slot 6
assets.variants: Visible: narrow blue glass bottle/flask, pale rim and small dark cap. Proposed: one static icon.
assets.notes: Only the icon appearance is certain; exact contents or function are not specified by the image.

assets.name: Wrench inventory icon
assets.location: Slot 7
assets.variants: Visible: diagonal grey open-end wrench with bright edge. Proposed: one static icon.
assets.notes: World-use animation is separate completion work.

assets.name: Amber lantern inventory icon
assets.location: Slot 8
assets.variants: Visible: dark handle/frame and bright amber body. Proposed: one static icon plus optional selected-use state.
assets.notes: The inventory icon remains bright even when the world changes lighting.

assets.name: Slot-number labels
assets.location: Below hotbar slots: 1 through 8
assets.variants: Visible: small pale digits. Proposed: reuse a small UI font.
assets.notes: These numerals are a smaller size than the currency/clock text. A separate small-size bitmap font may preserve crispness better than arbitrary scaling.

assets.name: Stack-count text
assets.location: Lower-right of seedling icon: 3
assets.variants: Visible: small pale numeral. Proposed: full small-digit set and quantity alignment.
assets.suggested_size: Same small UI font as slot labels
assets.notes: Draw quantities after the icon. Only one obvious quantity is visible, so other stack counts are a system requirement, not extra observed art.

assets.name: Cursor, tool ghost and placement feedback
assets.location: Interactive build/play mode
assets.variants: Proposed: pointer, tile hover outline, valid/invalid placement tint and connection-port highlight.
assets.notes: Not visible in the source image, but likely needed to turn the reconstruction into a building game. Keep out of the first screenshot-match render.
